# [PHANIX TECH](https://phanixtech.online/)
> Premium Full-Stack Web Development, 3D Web Apps, AI Workflows & Mobile Solutions Studio in Tamil Nadu, India.

## About PHANIX TECH
[PHANIX TECH](https://phanixtech.online/) is a high-performance software and digital engineering studio based in Tamil Nadu, India. We build modern websites, 3D interactive web applications, custom AI chatbots, workflow automations, and mobile apps.

## Services Offered
- **Web Design & Development**: High-converting websites built with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, GSAP motion, and Three.js 3D WebGL.
- **AI Automation & AI Chatbots**: Custom AI assistants powered by OpenAI API, n8n automated workflows, and CRM integrations.
- **Mobile App Development**: Cross-platform iOS & Android mobile applications built using Flutter & React Native.
- **UI/UX & Interactive Prototyping**: Pixel-perfect Figma design systems, motion wireframes, and digital brand identities.
